newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex ests upped by Morgan Stanley.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex ests upped by Morgan Stanley.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates for Mexican telephone giant Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) and reiterated its outperform rating on the stock.
-- Analyst Luiz Carvalho raised his 1997 earning per share to $3.74 from $3.22 and the 1998 figures to $4.20 from $4.01.
-- Carvalho said in a statement the new projections were made following last week's announcement of better-than-expected rate increases for local services.
